title: Sculpted Upper
description: Two classic upper body blocks: chest-shoulder push and pull with archer push-ups

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs, return feet together

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate cat and cow, breathe

exercises.name: Scapular push-ups
exercises.instructions: In a plank, squeeze and spread shoulder blades without bending elbows

exercises.name: Wide push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands wider than shoulders, focus on the chest

exercises.name: Archer push-ups
exercises.instructions: One arm extended to the side, lower toward the other hand

exercises.name: Pike push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hips high in an inverted V, lower head between hands

exercises.name: Inverse table rows
exercises.instructions: Under a table, pull chest toward the edge

exercises.name: Superman
exercises.instructions: Face down, lift arms and legs simultaneously, hold 2s

exercises.name: Prone Y raises
exercises.instructions: Face down, arms in a Y shape, lift and hold 2s

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate the body

exercises.name: Triceps stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm behind the head, pull the elbow with the other hand

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
